page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; running head "VI I." at top centre; page number 777 at top right; catchword "Vincu-" at bottom right; signature "Ccc 5" at foot centre. Faint show-through from the reverse page and a pencil stroke in the text are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Vimen ] Viminalia, pl. Plin. Vimenta, pl. Donat. Vi-burnum, Virg. Stamina contorti junci, Colvi.
Vimineus ] Viminalis salix, Col. Virgeus, Virg. Virgatus calathiscus, Catul. Vimine textum serpiculum, Col.
Vinaceus ] Vinalis fortitudo, Macrob. Vinarius lacus. Vineaticus fructus, Col. Vinosus succus, sapor, Plin.

Vincere hostem aliquem] Devincere aliquem bello. Consequi victoriam gloriosam. Reportare, adipisci victoriam: parta victoria, Cic. Patrare victoriam, Tac. Debellare aliquem, Plin. Frangere aliquem praelio, Cic. Superare aliquem pugnando, Ovid. Transgredi aliquem collatis signis, Plin.
Vincere se ipsum plus est, quam alios] Fortior est, qui se, quam fortissima vincit Moenia; nec virtus altius ire potest, Ovid.
Vince, si potes] Palma in medio est posita, Ter.
Vincibilis] Superabilis ulli non est, Ovid.

Vincire aliquem] Ligare in catenas, Quint. Colligare manus, Cic. Constringere catenis, laqueis, Cic. Indere alicui catenas, Plaut. Innectere vincula, Hor. Injicere vincula, Cic. Circumdare, adstringere vincula, Ovid. Instringere captivum vinculis, Quint. Destinare: Destinatis ejus membris, Apul. Arcae in aquam demittendae, destinandae firmiter, Vitr. (i. e. alligandae, Philand. Catenare, Cic. Injicere catenas alicui. Quadrupedes constringere, Vid. Ligare.
Vinctio] Conjugatio capitum, (f. in vitibus.) Colligatio causarum, societatis, Cic. Nexus, Ovid.
Vinctus ] Carcer, (pro homine carcere digno) Ter. Carcerarius, Donat. Custodia, Suet. Post terga revinctus, Virg. Catenatus. Retorta tergo brachia, Hor.

Vincula, orum] Mandare aeternis vinculis: abripi in vincula. Cic. Catenae, Id. In manibus gestant copulas, Plaut. i. e. vincula, Lamb. Nervo vinctus, Plaut. Custodia; dare, tradere, in custodiam; includere in custodias. Asservari privatis custodiis, Cic. Militari custodia haberi: haberi in custodia, Tac. Teneri in custodiis, Salust. Custodia libera, liberalis, Cic.

page.notes: Pencil marks and a stroke through "Vincere se ipsum" and "Destinare" are annotations, not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is ignored. Some letters in the text are uncertain where the ink is faint (e.g. "Ligare", "Vincire aliquem"), but the readings are given as printed.
